intro.title: Summary
intro.description: Results-driven Software Engineer with a focus on Generative AI and Data Engineering.

achievements: Modernized refund risk data workflows by converting legacy SAS processing logic to SQL. Streamlined the organization’s data stack and improved maintainability.
Designed and implemented a Jinja-based transpiler enabling shared data processing logic to run seamlessly on both Spark and SQLite, supporting tailored training and inference needs.

Architected a multi-stage data pipeline with Kedro, Azure ML, and Azure Synapse to build a LanceDB vector database for an internal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) application, enhancing data accessibility and performance.
Automated manual vector database refresh processes, eliminating manual operations and reducing engineering effort, enabling faster and more reliable data updates.
Engineered an open-source Machine Learning (ML) Feature Store for Gojek's driver-customer matchmaking model, enhancing data processing efficiency using Python, Java, Golang, Kafka, and Redis.
Resolved critical production issue by correcting Redis storage schema mismatch, ensuring uninterrupted matchmaking model performance.
Designed and deployed a comprehensive analytics dashboard using Grafana and GCP BigQuery, empowering management with real-time insights for data-driven decision-making.

projects.name: B+Tree Database in C++
achievements: Built a disk-backed B+Tree database in C++ with columnar storage and filesystem block-aligned I/O.
Implemented bulk-loaded B+Tree indexing to support efficient range-based aggregation queries
Achieved ~7x faster queries (1935µs -> 276µs) and 87\% fewer data block reads using index scan vs. brute force scan.

projects.name: Flowmotion
achievements: Engineered a real-time traffic congestion routing app that leverages live camera feeds and machine learning to deliver optimized routes for Singaporean drivers, improving commute efficiency.
Integrated a custom YOLOv8-based machine learning model to analyze traffic congestion, delivering real-time insights for route optimization using the OSRM API.
Developed a cross-platform mobile application with Flutter, ensuring seamless functionality on both iOS and Android, while managing scalable cloud infrastructure using Firebase and Google Cloud.
